summary_1line: A discourse praises Shiva’s many forms and names, recounts his aid to Arjuna, and concludes the Drona Parva with reflections on its spiritual merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: The god Shiva appears in a dream seated atop a towering mountain while Arjuna beholds him in awe under the night sky.
In a desolate cremation ground, fierce forms of Shiva are worshipped amid funeral fires and ash-covered ascetics.
A cosmic vision shows Shiva with countless eyes and radiant forms pervading the entire universe.
